max_tire.note: There's no 500 GE-specific consensus. On unlifted W463s, Expedition Portal owners say up to about 32 in clears without rubbing; 33s fit on 18-in wheels with a slight rub at full lock. Most owners keep these trucks on period-correct 16s.

timeline.change: W463 launches with permanent 4WD and three locking diffs, setting the base the 500 GE is built on
500 GE V8 launches at DM 178,250 with the 240 PS M117 V8, developed with AMG; planned run of 500
AMG offers the 500 GE 6.0 (5,959 cc) as an individual customer upgrade; RM Sotheby's believes about 13 were officially converted
Puch-badged 500 GEs built for the Austrian market; RM Sotheby's says three exist
Production ends at 446 units, limited by M117 supply because the newer M119 wouldn't fit the G's engine bay
The V8 returns in regular production as the G 500, with the M113 and all three locking diffs
The first 500 GEs pass 25 years old and become legal to import to the US
30th anniversary; well-kept examples now qualify for Germany's H (historic) plate after appraisal

identify.intro: With 446 built and plenty of later Gs wearing V8 badges and blue trim, the paperwork and chassis number are what prove a real 500 GE.

items.head: Chassis number
items.body: Documented 500 GEs share the model code 463.228 in the chassis number: WDB463228… on Mercedes-badged trucks (two RM Sotheby's cars and an armoured BaT car), VAG463228… on the Puch.

items.head: Two lockers, not three
items.body: Mercedes didn't offer a front differential lock on the 500 GE, so it has only the centre and rear locks. A front-lock switch suggests a later G or a conversion.

items.head: Body and colour
items.body: Long-wheelbase station wagon only. Standard trucks are Amethyst Blue metallic (DB 3338) with the bumpers, wheel-arch flares and mirror housings in the same colour. Special-request paint exists: RM Sotheby's sold one in Avantgarde Verde.

items.head: Interior
items.body: Black leather with medium-grey seat centres and door panels, and walnut on the centre console, handbrake, selector levers and door trim. Automatic, air conditioning, cruise control, sunroof and heated seats were standard.

items.head: AMG 6.0
items.body: The genuine AMG 500 GE 6.0 has a 5,959 cc M117. RM Sotheby's cites option code ZB6, '500 GE (AMG)', checked on the data card. Badges alone prove nothing.

capability.note: Mercedes doesn't publish the figure in its 30th-anniversary story

values.intro: The 500 GE is a rarity whose value depends on provenance, so auction results are scattered rather than tracing a clear trend.

paragraphs: The 500 GE was never sold new in the US, and it isn't part of the Europa International story. US examples are private imports; German Cars For Sale Blog documents one that went through Wallace test labs in 2005 and is California-registered. NHTSA allows any vehicle at least 25 years old to be imported, counted from its date of manufacture, so every 500 GE now qualifies under Box 1 of the HS-7 form. Check your state's titling and emissions rules.
